title: Continuously Improving Agents with Langfuse — Annabell Schäfer & Lotte Verheyden, ClickHouse
talk_summary: A Langfuse workshop showing how to instrument an agent with traces, then attach LLM-as-judge and code-based evaluators to production traces to surface failure modes (user disagreement, frustration, out-of-scope requests). They then point a coding agent with a Langfuse CLI/skill at live traces to auto-detect silent failures and propose fixes.

takeaways.technique: Cheap code-based evaluators on production traces
takeaways.what_they_do: Run deterministic Python/TS evaluator functions over a JSON path of each trace (e.g. detect all-caps frustration, brand-name casing) and tag observations with boolean scores, then filter traces by score.
takeaways.evidence_quote: it's checking if there's all caps in there and in case it's doing all caps then we return a um a boolean score true

takeaways.technique: LLM-as-judge on root observation with JSON-path variable mapping
takeaways.what_they_do: Configure an LLM evaluator targeting the root agent observation, mapping message history and last user message via JSON paths into the judge prompt, running live on every new trace.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we want to go um not for the generation um but for the agent that is the root um of the whole uh trace

takeaways.what_they_do: Define evaluators for failure modes specific to the app (out-of-scope requests comparing system prompt vs user intent; silent retrieval failures) rather than copying generic templates.
takeaways.evidence_quote: it's really about thinking what is what are the typical fail modes we will um endure in our kind of application

takeaways.technique: Coding agent + CLI/skill over live traces for bulk diagnosis
takeaways.what_they_do: Install a Langfuse CLI/skill into a coding agent so it can query live traces, scores, latency and tool-call errors, then produce a report of issues and even patch the repo.
takeaways.evidence_quote: please use the length fuse skill to find issues in our traces
takeaways.numbers: around 120 traces or it was 70 traces

takeaways.what_they_do: Start with tracing+monitoring only, make quick fixes from traces; later promote interesting production traces into datasets for offline experiments and CI regression gating.
takeaways.evidence_quote: A lot of teams that are not in high risk industries can actually just start with these two

takeaways.what_they_do: A packaged skill lets the coding agent set up tracing automatically and later apply fixes to the repo based on trace findings.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we also have a lengthy skill that you can use to automatically get it set up
